maddeler.e:
تلتحمن (form VIII)
# تَلْتَحِمْنَ (taltaḥimna) /tal.ta.ħim.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِلْتَحَمَ (iltaḥama)
# تُلْتَحَمْنَ (tultaḥamna) /tul.ta.ħam.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِلْتَحَمَ (iltaḥama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
